notes.title: V1.1.1 (minor changes)
notes.notes:
V:1.1.1 patch note:
[list]
[*] The menu at the end of the Safe Orders as well as Order 7 now displays the best time correctly.
[*] There is now an arrow appearing above the key when being trapped in the cell.
[*] Increased a bit the door closing duration.
[*] Difficulty balance changes.
[/list]

Have any feedback? Here's the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/NnuKZca2t5]https://discord.gg/NnuKZca2t5[/url]

(previous version: V:1.1.0)
